_note: v12 (25 Oct 2026): metal share 20%, film 45%, horror outlets up to 6 stories each; front-page rules for Tonight's Lead (lead.frontpage), metal may lead only with a horror element, Blu-ray.com / HD-style disc news judged on headline + first sentence with strict horror words, Hell's Hundred / Crooked Lane / Clash / Nightfire horror-only. v11: lead image, gear floor, collectible sources. Mirror of 03-night-wire-taxonomy.md.
exclude_notes: Also exclude ranked listicles with no news peg, AI-generated aggregator sites, hard-paywalled articles. Remake/reboot excludes apply to development news; the original as subject is fine.
standing_exception: New work by living Tier 1 figures passes without a qualifier.

frontpage._note: A story qualifies for Tonight's Lead by meeting ONE rule. Qualifiers rank top tier first, then by score. If none qualifies, the best non-metal, non-gear horror story leads, as before. Names are checked in the headline. Names under 'ambiguous' (It, Halloween, Saw…) count only when the title is in quotes (‘Saw’), in capitals inside a mixed-case headline (Flanagan's CARRIE), or next to one of the entry's own 'context' words (Pennywise, Michael Myers…). Headlines matching not_news_patterns (reviews, anniversaries, explainers, questions, opinion) can't qualify: the lead is news.
